agendas.name: Sow the Seeds of Corruption
agendas.description: Pre-game: select 1 objective per table zone. At end of turn, if a DEATH GUARD INFANTRY unit is in range of a selected objective with no enemy nearby, seed it and select that unit for 2XP. Post-game: 2 seeded objectives = D6 on 4+ gain +1 Fecundity; 3 seeded = +1 Fecundity automatically.

agendas.name: Unwitting Vectors
agendas.description: Post-game: roll D6 per surviving enemy unit (+2 if Below Starting Strength). On 6+, gain +1 Survival Rate and select one non-destroyed DEATH GUARD unit for 3XP.

agendas.name: Viral Harvest
agendas.description: Before shooting, task a DEATH GUARD INFANTRY unit to exhume a controlled Vector Target in No Man's Land (no shoot/charge). On success: 1XP. Max 3XP per unit. Post-game: roll D6 + total successful exhumes; on 7+, gain +1 Adaptability.

agendas.name: Vile Research
agendas.description: Each time a DEATH GUARD unit destroys an Afflicted enemy unit, gain +1 research tally and the destroying unit gains 1XP (max 3XP per unit). Post-game: 1-3 research tally = use Tailor the Toxins once; 4+ = use it twice.
